modules.name: 9A9
modules.description: TR-909 style drum machine: 11 voices with their own triggers and outputs, drive, reverb, delay

modules.name: 9A9 SEQ
modules.description: 9A9 expander: the 11-lane step sequencer with swing and pattern generator

modules.name: 9A9 CV
modules.description: 9A9 expander: a CV input for every voice control, voice by voice

modules.name: 9A9 MOD
modules.description: 9A9 expander: six CV slots, learn any 9A9 control

modules.name: 9A9 MIX
modules.description: 9A9 expander: a stereo mixer of the 11 voices, level, pan and mute each
